title: Watcher.Fai
tagline: Watcher.Fai is your personal agentic defi account manager. Offload all your tedious tracking and management of funds across multiple Dapps and protocols or create new positions by conversing with our Watcher.Fai agent.
description: Watcher.Fai is your personal agentic defi account manager that helps keep track of your interactions on the blockchain such as positions on different protocols, yields, and earnings from pools. It will keep you up to date on what you borrowed, fees earned from pools and much more. This tool is extremely useful for someone who has a lot of open positions. It will be hard to manage all of them going to different sites, but Watcher.Fai is that personal agentic account manager who can manage them all and provide feedback in one place. It is your one-stop shop to access the world of defi through a personal ai agent.
